patch.objective: Supervising delegated care and evaluating the outcome rather than assuming it
secondaryObjectives: What can never be delegated: assessment, evaluation, teaching, unstable clients
Apply the right circumstance: delegate only for a stable client, and require the delegatee to report any change so the nurse can reassess whether delegation is still safe
